item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "cb097e412318caf35d38bfb0e15763dd38ef9d9083f99e167726ecd19c13698a",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a finite coordinate set, there exist vectors qt and qx such that the time derivative of q at fixed x is qt at t, the spatial derivative at fixed t is qx at x, and qt + fluxDerivative(q(x,t))(qx) = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The target denies this entire conjunction of derivative existence and equation for every assignment of continuous linear operators.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Every spatial slice of q is integrable on every finite interval; every time slice of flux composed with q at fixed position is integrable on every finite interval; and for all real a,b,s,t, integral_a^b q(x,t) dx minus integral_a^b q(x,s) dx equals integral_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) - flux(q(b,τ))] dτ.",
      "effect_on_target": "This global integral balance and both integrability requirements are the first hypothesis of the universal implication and a requirement on the existential example.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on real-valued functions on any index type is jointly continuous in the product topology.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication needed by the derivative predicates in LocalDef001; adds no hypothesis on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the ordinary additive operations used in the real module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the real scalar action used in the continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both the universal conditional assertion and the existential assertion, and all nested conjuncts.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "ContinuousAt",
      "meaning": "The image under f of the neighborhood filter at x tends to the neighborhood filter at f(x).",
      "effect_on_target": "Its negation says the spatial slice is discontinuous at the specified point in the usual real and finite product topologies.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ContinuousLinearMap",
      "meaning": "A continuous semilinear map for the specified scalar ring homomorphism; for the identity real homomorphism, a continuous real-linear map.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each value of fluxDerivative is a continuous real-linear endomorphism of the vector state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field is regarded as a nontrivially normed field with the same norm and field operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar field structure required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DifferentiableAt",
      "meaning": "There exists a continuous linear map that is a Fréchet derivative of the function at the point.",
      "effect_on_target": "The target denies real Fréchet differentiability of the spatial slice at x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a multiplicative action from an action distributing over addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action used in coordinate differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real semiring operations for the vector module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "There is an element of the stated type satisfying the predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies derivative witnesses inside LocalDef001 and jointly chosen q, flux, x, t in the second main conjunct.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's commutative division and semiring structure as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real scalar structure without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Filter.Eventually",
      "meaning": "The set on which the predicate holds belongs to the specified filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "With the almost-everywhere filter, the derivative equality holds outside a null set of times.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the finite type of natural indices strictly less than m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The state has m real coordinates indexed 0 through m-1; the existential assertion specifically uses Fin 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices of Fin n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides finiteness for the state space's norm and for LocalDef001.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Applies the subtraction operation from the selected instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms vector differences of fluxes and integrals in the displayed order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified vector-valued derivative at the point, using the full neighborhood of that point and the point as fixed base.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses ordinary two-sided derivatives of real-parameter functions, both for the interval integral and for spatial and temporal slices.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector space structure of an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual normed real scalar space used in the finite product.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology makes scalar multiplication jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a continuity instance for real scalar multiplication, without restricting q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has continuous semiring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the usual real scalar continuity structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring has its module topology as a module over itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of the ordinary real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected strict order relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the strict positivity 0 < t in the existential conjunct.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "A measure on the supplied measurable space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the measure object underlying integration and almost-everywhere quantification.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on sets through its underlying outer measure, with values in the extended nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows exceptional sets to be required to have measure zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instOuterMeasureClass",
      "meaning": "Measures satisfy the outer-measure interface for evaluating arbitrary sets.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables the null-set filter used for almost-everywhere differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the measurable space from a space with a designated measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the measurable sets for the real integration measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the designated measure of a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects real volume for all integrals and the almost-everywhere assertion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.ae",
      "meaning": "The filter of sets whose complements have measure zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The exceptional times for each fixed pair a,b have real volume zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves coordinatewise real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the associative multiplication of a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited scalar multiplication structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative action structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action appearing in differentiation instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The universal dimension m may be zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement while retaining the operations of a nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inherited real ring structure for topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the commutativity requirement of the specified ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Leaves real operations unchanged in the topological ring interface.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies coordinate addition and zero for real vector modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic nonunital commutative ring from its normed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real algebraic operations used by topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the commutativity requirement while retaining the seminormed ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the ordinary seminormed additive structure on real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains a ring's norm, additive group, and compatible pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed additive data used for real scalar and vector spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement of a nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited real additive structure without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real normed field operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's operations and metric while dropping the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same real norm and operations for inherited structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Regards the norm and metric of a normed commutative ring as a seminorm and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and topology used in the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real arithmetic underlying scalar operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's commutative ring, norm, and metric structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the usual real topology in scalar multiplication and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real-linear operations for derivatives and continuous linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Negation of P is the implication P implies false.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denies continuity, all proposed spatial derivative values, differentiability, and LocalDef001.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural numeral through the specified instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 1 as the existential state dimension and 0 as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "The module structure on functions obtained by pointwise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin m → Real the real vector space of m coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The pointwise commutative additive group on a family of functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition, negation, and subtraction act coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The pointwise commutative additive monoid on a family of functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides coordinatewise addition and zero for linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.instSub",
      "meaning": "Function subtraction is defined by (f-g)(i) = f(i)-g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Flux and integral differences are vector differences coordinate by coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The finite product normed additive group induced by the coordinate normed groups.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite-dimensional normed state space for vector integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "The finite product normed vector space with pointwise module operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables real vector-valued integrals and derivatives for the states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology generated by the coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Continuity and differentiability use the usual finite product topology on the state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible uniform structure of a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the ordinary real metric to the neighborhood topology used in calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "A real-or-complex-like scalar field is a real inner product space with its compatible norm and real scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "At Real, supplies the standard one-dimensional real normed space for each coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Positions, times, interval endpoints, scalars, and vector coordinates are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real normed field has norm values between any appropriate strictly separated nonnegative bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivial normed scalar field required for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate addition used in module topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The commutative additive group of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive coordinate structure of the state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The commutative additive monoid of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real addition and zero for function modules and linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The usual real commutative semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity real algebra and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the existential witness time to be strictly positive.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real field as a real-or-complex-like field, with real part the identity and imaginary part and distinguished imaginary element zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real normed and inner product structures; no complex coordinates are introduced.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The usual real ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies arithmetic for vector modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction a-b is a plus the negative of b.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the signs of coordinatewise flux and integral differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is the lower bound in 0 < t and the coordinate value of the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The designated standard measure space on the reals, whose volume is Lebesgue measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "All interval integrability, integrals, and almost-everywhere claims use real Lebesgue measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate normed groups for the vector state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The usual real commutative ring with its compatible norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary real arithmetic and topology in inherited instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real field with its absolute-value norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field and norm used for vector spaces and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real metric given by distance |x-y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Spatial and temporal neighborhoods are ordinary real neighborhoods.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The usual real semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies scalar operations for real-linear maps and modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains ordinary real addition and multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "RingHom.id",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the continuous semilinear maps ordinary real-linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a semifield's division semiring operations while forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real scalar structure without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar action operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects ordinary real scalar multiplication in the calculus instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Drops the unit requirement while retaining ring operations, seminorm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real seminormed additive structure used in normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure, forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real norm and topology in the scalar continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real topology used for scalar multiplication continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts multiplication, one, and absorbing zero from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the usual real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement while retaining semiring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structure used to form the identity real ring homomorphism.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in inherited module data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology of a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real topology for continuity and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D089",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets numeral zero using the designated zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "The numeral in 0 < t is real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D090",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise jointly continuous scalar actions induce a jointly continuous scalar action on the product.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the continuous scalar multiplication needed for vector-valued derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D091",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary subtraction operation as homogeneous heterogeneous subtraction.",
